releases.displayName: Language Update Beta Testing + Merch News

items.text: Hello! We are happy to announce that 4 new languages (Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Russian) are now available for public testing on the Mewgenics beta branch. If you wish to help test these languages please subscribe to the Beta branch in the game's properties setting on steam, and then switch the language in-game (switching from Steam will be enabled once the patch exits beta). Once any issues with these are cleaned up it will go live on steam for everyone. Thank you for your patience, we know this took longer than expected.

If you have any feedback about the translations when playing the beta, please email it to localizationfeedback@glaielgames.com. This is the only place that will be monitored for localization feedback.

こんにちは！ みなさんに嬉しいお知らせです。4つの新しい言語版（日本語、韓国語、簡体字中国語、ロシア語）が、Mewgenicsのベータブランチから、パブリックテストでプレイできるようになりました。これらの言語版のプレイテストを手伝いたいプレイヤーは、ゲームの「プロパティ」からベータ版に参加し、ゲーム内で言語設定を切り替えてください（Steamからの設定切り替えは、言語パッチがベータ版から正式版に移行したあとに有効にする予定です）。すべての問題が解決したあかつきには、各言語版をSteamで一般向けにリリースする予定です。辛抱強く待ってくださってありがとうございます。予定より長くお待たせしてしまいましたね。
ベータ版をプレイし、翻訳についてフィードバックしたくなったプレイヤーは、localizationfeedback@glaielgames.comまでＥメールでご連絡ください。ローカライズのフィードバックは、このアドレスでのみ受け付けます。
안녕하세요! 4개의 신규 언어 (한국어, 일본어, 중국어 (간체), 러시아어)를 Mewgenics 베타 버전에서 이용하실 수 있습니다!
위 신규 언어들의 테스트에 기여하고 싶으시다면, Steam의 게임 속성에서 베타 버전을 선택하신 다음, 게임 내에서 언어를 변경해 주세요. Steam을 통한 언어 변경은 베타 테스트 종료 후 지원될 예정입니다. 정식 버전에서의 언어 지원은 베타 테스트에서 발견된 이슈들을 해결한 뒤 서비스 예정입니다.
베타 테스트 도중 번역 관련한 피드백이 있으실 경우, localizationfeedback@glaielgames.com 로 보내주시면 감사하겠습니다. 번역 관련 피드백은 위의 메일을 통해서만 확인하고 있습니다. 예상보다 더 오랜 시간이 걸렸지만, 너그럽게 기다려 주신 유저 여러분께 감사드립니다.

Всем привет! У нас для вас хорошие новости: 4 новых языка (японский, корейский, упрощённый китайский и русский) теперь доступны в публичной бете Mewgenics. Если вы хотите помочь с отловом багов перевода и почухать котиков с именами на своих языках, вы можете сменить версию игры на бету в настройках игры в Steam, а затем выбрать интересующий вас язык в настройках самой игры (сменить язык напрямую в Steam можно будет, когда новые переводы выйдут из беты). А выйдут они из беты, когда мы будем уверены, что они полностью готовы увидеть свет. Благодарим за терпение, – мы прекрасно понимаем, что многие из вас ожидали переводы намного раньше.

Если у вас появятся отзывы и предложения по переводу во время игры в бету, вы можете присылать их на localizationfeedback@glaielgames.com. ВНИМАНИЕ: пишите только на эту электронную почту, отзывы и предложения по переводу по другим каналам рассматриваться не будут, спасибо!
大家好！简体中文、日文、韩文和俄文四个新语种已装进《喵喵的结合》的beta分支，开始进行公开测试。如果愿意协助测试，请在Steam的库右击游戏，点击“属性”，选择“beta branch”，然后在游戏内切换语种（beta测试结束之后，游戏将支持直接在Steam切换这几个语种）。四个语种的相关问题全部解决之后，将正式在Steam上线。我们明白这一批语种比预计来得晚了一些，感谢大家耐心等待！
Beta测试期间，如果对本地化的具体内容有什么反馈，请发送邮件至localizationfeedback@glaielgames.com或填写调查问卷（https://v.wjx.cn/vm/ezSPziK.aspx）。我们将密切关注反馈，再次感谢大家！

Hello! Here's an update on future language support. All of these are taking a little bit longer than initially expected, due to these not using the Latin alphabet (which requires some extra work on font support and some extra care in picking new fonts for these languages) and translators needing to spend some extra time on edits + keeping up with text changes in the recently released balance patch. Nonetheless these languages have been in the works and have been making steady progress, here's an update from the translators for each one currently in the works:
Japanese
公式日本語翻訳八割ほど終わっています！お楽しみに！

Дорогие фанаты, русский перевод идёт полным ходом, большая часть текстов уже готова и находится на вычитке. Мы с командой разработчиков также активно работаем над локализацией шрифтов, чтобы гонять котиков в приключения было ещё и красиво. Надеемся порадовать вас переводом ближе к концу июня. Спасибо за ожидание!

notes.title: Mewgenics Beta Branch Balance Patch Notes v1.1

items.text: These changes are for the BETA BRANCH of the game. See here for how to subscribe to the beta. Some of these changes are subject to change based on feedback before going live on main.
Fixed some issues with high amounts of negative Stimulation.
Fixed Stimulation treating birth defects on parents the same as positive mutations. Higher stimulation now decreases the chance of birth defects on parents being inherited.
The effects of Stimulation are now reduced the more inbred a kitten is.
The chances of inheriting a parent's birth defect are significantly increased the more inbred the kitten is.
"Mutation" stat will no longer reroll any existing mutations or birth defects.
"Mutation" stat will now only roll simple mutations (+2/-1 stat ones) until >10 Mutation. More Mutation beyond this will increase the chance of rolling mutations with effects.
Heads that have 1 eye/eyebrow/ear (ex. Cyclops) will no longer also count as the "Missing" birth defect for the other eye/eyebrow/ear.
Chance of inheriting a voice from a parent is now 75% instead of 98%.
Baphomet: Removed bad outcomes from sacrifice and lose 10 HP options.
Steven Fetus: Removed Deja Vu from bad event outcome and replaced with a new pool of disorders for it.
Sacrificial Altar: Removed bad outcomes from sacrificing cats.
Itchies or Wheezies: Itchies now also gives a forever flea familiar and Wheezies now also gives +2 LCK.
Insatiable Rage tragedy no longer only gives Blood Frenzy.
Infestation weather event: Units now only spawn charmed maggots when killed.
Hypersomnia: fixed order Sleep applies so that passives/items affecting sleep can trigger correctly.
Malaria: Now only reduces CON.
Naegleria Fowleri: Become AI controlled instead of dead at 0 INT.
Schrodinger’s Syndrome: +1 to all stats and gain an extra turn at the start of battle.
Sociopathy: -5 CHA, +5 INT.
Cleanse: Is now single-target. Range increased to compensate. Upgrade changed to make it hit a large area.
Open Wounds: Now deals magic damage.
Plant Mushroom: -2 mana cost.
Summon Caterpillar: -1 mana cost.
Merciless: No longer triggers during actions that cost movement points.
Ball Of Spiders: No longer scales damage with DEX.
Egg Sac Trap: -1 mana cost.
Flea Shot: No longer scales damage with DEX.
Heavy shot: -2 damage, 50% miss chance, +1 mana cost.
Hunter's Boon: Now only triggers once per turn, but triggers off of any kill and not just enemies.
Scattershot: +3 mana cost. Upgrade no longer exempts allies from its radius.
Mage Basic attack: +2 range.
Blizzard: Reworked to deal very high damage with 100% Freeze (and no Slow).
Bolt: +2 range.
Burning Paws: +1 Burn. (upgrade +2 Burn.)
Fire Blast: +2 range.
Firebolt: +2 range, +1 damage.
Five: Trigger is now exactly 5 Mana or HP.
Forbidden Spells: Now have 2 separate disorder pools, a basic pool (90% chance) and a crippling pool (10% chance). Psychosis is in the crippling pool. Luck affects which pool is chosen.
Forbidden Flame: Burn increased.
Forbidden Flood: Damage increased.
Forbidden Frost: Damage/heal increased.
Forbidden Fulmination: Damage increased.
Four: Trigger is now exactly 4 Mana or HP.
Freezerburn: +1 attack radius
Ice Paws: +2 Slow, +5% freeze chance. You can damage frozen units. (upgrade +3 Slow.)
Icicle Zapper: +1 damage.
Jolt: +2 range.
Inferno: Now deals 8 damage, 8 Burn (upgrade 12 damage 10 Burn).
Lightning Paws: +1 damage, +5% Stun chance. (upgrade +2 damage, +7% Stun chance.)
Light up the Stage: +1 sparkle per turn. (upgrade +3 sparkles per turn)
Long Cast: +2 range. (upgrade +5 range, +1 magic damage.)
Overload: +2 damage. (upgrade +4 damage.)
Shatter: -1 mana cost.
Thunderburst: Now deals 12 damage, 50% Stun (upgrade 16 damage, 100% Stun)
Tri-Attack: +2 range +1 damage.
Fist of Fate+: repeat must hit different targets each time.
Stance Switch: ai control now attempts to use this if it’s out of other actions.
Evil Incarnate: -3 mana cost.
Flesh Golem: -3 hp cost per cat to cast.
Shatter the Sky: -2 mana cost.
Ass Blast: -1 mana cost, +2 Knockback.
Clap: -1 mana cost.
Caltrops: +1 movement. (upgrade +5 movement.)
Nail Flurry+: Multi-hit amount is now locked in when the ability is cast instead of updating mid-ability if DEX is gained or lost.
Poison Gas: +1 poison. (upgrade +2 poison)
Tinkerer Basic Craft/Throw: AI is slightly better at sequencing these now. (prefers to craft without wasting move first, prefers to use weapon before throwing it)
Added "Blast Resistance" status effect. Blast resistance is added onto EMP, Mr. Mega, Napalm, and Demo Man tinkerer passives.
Throw Weapon: no longer costs an action to use.
Bombchu: -2 mana cost.
Build Nuke: -2 mana cost.
Conductor: now makes your weapon inflict electric damage if you are wearing metal.
Electrolyze: -2 mana cost.
EMP: +1 explosion damage. (upgrade +2 explosion damage.)
Firecrackers: -2 mana cost.
Lightning Rod: now grants Tech instead of Charge. Upgrade now grants Energized.
Math!: now deals electric damage + stuns on prime numbers. Upgrade now gives you Tech on prime number instead of refunding mana.
Mr. Mega: +1 blast radius, +2 explosion damage. (upgrade +4 explosion damage.)
Napalm: +2 Burn. (upgrade +4 Burn.)
Rocket Ride: -2 mana cost.
Hitler's suicide can no longer miss. Increased the shield amount on his explosive phase.
Added +4 HP to Führerfötuses.
Final Boss & his Cat Clones are banned from rolling Depressing elite buff.
Soahc's form change now ignores combat speed setting.
Added +50 HP to The Coven and Tormentor.
Added +50 HP to Dreadnoughtus’ head and +2 damage to its legs.
Cursed Items and Parasites are no longer excluded from item degradation.
Head mutation that gives you a bonus turn now has -2 speed.
Spewer: HP nerfed to 100
Stacy: base HP buffed to 125
Inventory "Slot" sort order now matches the order shown above the cat.
Jester collar will always appear at the end of the class list, even if unlocked before Monk.
Inventory/Furniture "Alphabetical" sort lists now use locales for sorting (change needed for some future language support).
Backpack button added to shop screens.
The tooltip for items with active abilities now shows the ability button in the tooltip.
Added element indicators to item buttons.
Misc tooltip fixes (Half-Rat, Robotic Arm).
Misc localization fixes.
Misc typos fixed.
Fixed incorrect tiles in one level in The Rift.
Fixed Rare Cat Tree C's art not matching collision.
Loot cutscenes now all show a fallback cat for moral support if you loot with only one cat in the party.
New cat vocal sound sets added.
Fixed Champion Katzebot portrait not properly showing.
Added tooltip icon for Temporary Item.
Gave RiftKitten tooltip text.
Added fallback behavior for another type of save file corruption
Some random rolls with 0% or 100% odds will no longer advance the RNG.
Gameplay Changes
Arthur is banned from using Forbidden Famine as well
When hovering a character, health and statuses are now displayed on top of the portrait and turn order UI
Depressing elite buff is now muted if the elite is off-map

All "Status Immunity" type effects now purge their relevant statuses on application to prevent an initialization order dependency where, for example, an item that makes you "poison immune" wouldn't prevent poison from a disorder (which was applied before the poison immunity item)
Fixed "Status Immunity" type effects missing a few other ways statuses could get applied
Hexagram Sigil's Buff Immunity now has an exception for Magic Damage Up so the item can work as written
Fixed Flaming Fists disorder not showing its icon properly
Fixed Dybbuk softlocking if you backflip his possession ability
Fixed Dybbuk softlocking if the map is full when he tries to exit a body (he just instantly dies in this case now)
Fixed Empty Sack, Scrap Bag, and Lucky Coin having their rarity misspelled causing them to be missing from their rarity specific item pools
Fixed Metal Coat not working on items with a chance to break (ex Bone Club)
Fixed incorrect behavior if a 2x2 or larger character is standing on multiple glass tiles and is hit with a physical attack
Fixed rare case where Needles event could have no options shown if the event somehow rolled multiple times in the same run
Fixed case where ending a fight by throwing a charged soul dagger could crash the game
Fixed performance drop when examining The Collective's attack range if there's a lot of them
Fixed another case of debug text showing in event art

Fixed being able to click offscreen buttons if you stretch the game's window
Fixed Stone Breath not getting cheaper when upgraded
Fixed Pierce (thief active) not providing shield piercing to attacks where pass through is irrelevant.
Fixed Naegleria Fowleri not applying Brace properly
Fixed CharmedRaptorBaby not having the proper portrait
Fixed case where a cat would be lost from the save file if it went into the cat-shaped hole and you lose the run before it returns
Fixed case where the family tree would crash if trying to display an ancestor that had been lost from the save file (should display a blank portrait in its place now)
Fixed Bloody Soul Claw healing what it attacks instead of healing yourself on kill
Fixed Eternal Health+ having a maximum for how much luck it can grant
Fixed another case where certain kinds of jump animations could desync visual and actual positions of characters
Fixed 5 more items having incorrect rarity set and being undroppable as a result
Edited Champion Abandoned One portrait
Couple of typos fixed
Misc localization fixes

Reversed the loading priority when multiple mod paths are specified. This should make the ordering more in line with how other games work. (Details: Loading priority is now {resources.gpak, loose files in same directory, modpath 0, modpath 1, modpath 2, ...} where files in later paths override files in newer paths. You can specify "." in the mod path list to change the loose file priority, though this is optional.)

Added a settings file option "validate_pedigree_tables true" (or pass "-validate_pedigree_tables true" to steam launch options) to attempt to repair broken pedigree tables when loading a save file. Broken pedigree tables were caused by changing family tree information in one of the save file editor mods, and could result in the game freezing when ending the day.
